method: Supplement register R3 for Scope 3 categories 3D, 7, 4/8/9/10/13/14 and 11. EPA GHG Emission Factors Hub (January 15, 2025) Table 1 rows 17-83 (every stationary-combustion fuel with a default heat content; heat content HHV, kg CO2, g CH4 and g N2O per mmBtu), Table 11 and Table 12 AR5 100-year GWPs, each value the shortest round-trip decimal of the stored workbook cell and, rounded to the printed decimals, equal to the same-edition Hub PDF. One stored value differs from its printed form beyond rounding noise in the binary double only: Blast Furnace Gas CH4 (F40) is stored 0.022000000000000002 and printed 0.022; the stored value is used, as for every other cell. Table 12 GWPs count only the HFC and PFC constituents of a blend (note C591). eGRID2023 rev2: U.S. total output emission rates (US23 U3:W3); subregion and U.S. annual net generation (SRL23 SRNGENAN, US23 USNGENAN); plant heat input from combustion (PLNT23 PLHTIAN) summed by subregion and plant primary fuel category, asserted to add up exactly to SRHTIAN for all 27 subregions and to USHTIAN. Values are published values; no factor is derived or typed by hand.
